name: Buurttuin
scene: A welcoming contemporary Dutch community garden with raised timber vegetable beds, terracotta pots, leafy climbing beans, a glass greenhouse at the upper right, gravel and warm brick paths, softly lit late afternoon. Route diagonally crosses the garden in one open sweeping curve. A tall bean trellis near tile 5 has a visible front crossbar above the walking route; do not cover the tile centre. Finish just inside the open greenhouse entrance. No water or bridges.
decor: One bean trellis centred at (785,675), narrow front horizontal wooden bar at y=660. The path passes behind the trellis at tile5 (770,710).

name: Bibliotheek
scene: A spacious beautiful Dutch public library interior, open roof cutaway viewed from elevated oblique angle. Honey oak bookshelves, warm cream plaster, broad windows, reading chairs and lamps, large open walkable floor. The route passes through distinct open reading zones, not a maze. Shelves occupy unused spaces between route runs; nothing covers the colourful tiles. Finish at the upper-right reading alcove. No bridges, no water.
decor: A low bookcase at x680..780 y380..430, front top edge y410, so the pawn can pass behind its end between tiles9 and10 without walking through wood.

name: Museum
scene: An elegant Dutch museum interior as an open roof cutaway with three connected spacious galleries: archaeology at left, paintings in centre, contemporary sculpture at right. Warm limestone floors, burgundy and sage walls, soft skylights. Clearly open doorways between galleries, floor continuous through doors, adult cultured atmosphere. Architecture in upper/back parts, not covering route stones. Finish at the right-hand sculpture hall.
decor: Open doorway between gallery1 and2 at x610 y370, another between gallery2 and3 at x1100 y285. Keep open floor clearance 100px. Frames can cover the pawn head but never block the route.

name: Onderwaterwereld
scene: A luminous underwater world with a wide transparent glass pedestrian tube on pale stone supports, curving through coral gardens, past a distant wooden shipwreck to a scientific sea laboratory on the far right. All colourful route tiles form the walkable floor INSIDE the tube; people would stay dry. Teal water, blue sunlight shafts, subtle distant fish, realistic adult painted illustration. The left descending curve and right ascending curve are different levels. A solid coral-covered rock arch covers the tube ONLY between tile14 and15. Draw two distinct dark tunnel mouths exactly at the coordinates specified. No surface path between those tunnel mouths.
decor: Rock tunnel entrance mouth centre (940,660), base (920,690), exterior arch x870..1000 y560..700. Exit mouth centre (1030,515), base (1050,550), exterior arch x970..1090 y435..565. Their openings face down toward the corresponding route end. No coloured tiles inside the rock.

name: Jungle
scene: A rich tropical rainforest in a broad diagonal panorama from a river landing at lower left to a modest field research cabin upper right. Giant leaves, tree ferns, layered humid canopy, bright morning light. The route uses open clearings and a suspended wooden footbridge between tiles12 and13 across a narrow rocky ravine. A second passage between tiles20 and21 goes behind a waterfall with two visible cave entrances. No other hidden paths. Detailed adult painted landscape, not cartoon. Keep every route tile visible.
decor: Bridge12→13 from (550,335) to (750,370), sturdy deck floor connecting route, far rope at y305..340 and near rope at y350..385. Waterfall rock mouths: entrance (1390,300) base (1360,325), arch x1300..1460 y220..345; exit (1380,185) base (1345,210), arch x1310..1450 y110..225. Waterfall at x1480 behind rock, do not obscure tile20 or21.

name: Woestijn
scene: A vast sunlit desert of warm ochre dunes and monumental weathered sandstone, a small adobe settlement lower left, lush oasis and modest buildings far right. Not an icy or woodland composition. A wide open looping route across firm sand enters a short sandstone passage between tile11 and12, emerges on the opposite side of the narrow rock ridge and continues down a broad ramp to the oasis. Sunlit terracotta, pale gold, soft long shadows, huge open sky and sand. Mature detailed painted boardgame family style. Every tile on level walkable sand or a broad gentle ramp, no floating tiles.
decor: Sandstone tunnel entrance mouth at (575,170), base (550,195), arch x500..640 y80..210; exit mouth at (685,210), base (710,240), arch x620..760 y115..250. Rock ridge connects them behind the openings; clear portal silhouettes and no tiles inside rock.

name: Kasteel
scene: A beautiful historic brick and limestone castle viewed as a broad elevated open-roof cutaway. Start outside at lower left, cross a short wooden drawbridge over a narrow moat between tiles3 and4, continue across the open courtyard, along wide walkable ramparts and through a covered gate passage between tiles23 and24 into a grand open-roof hall at right. Autumn daylight, burgundy ivy, weathered masonry, warm lamps. Moat only along lower-left outer wall, not a large central water lake. Every tile on a solid broad walkway, every doorway tall enough for a pawn.
decor: Drawbridge3→4 deck connects (365,670) to (515,625), front railing near y690..645, back railing y635..590. Gate entrance mouth (800,110), base (780,135), frame x735..860 y35..150; gate exit mouth (940,125), base (975,150), frame x885..1020 y40..165. Keep upper gates inside canvas and no route in the hidden passage.

name: Bergdorp
scene: A spectacular alpine village panorama with two distinct walkable village slopes separated by a deep wooded valley. Lower-left village in warm afternoon sun, upper-right village in clear cool mountain light, slate roofs and flowering balconies, distant peaks. A single cableway travels diagonally over the valley between tile14 and15; draw empty two parallel support cables from boarding station (740,340) to arrival station (1050,240) but NO CABIN because the app animates it. No footpath across the ravine. The left route climbs through the village; the right route continues around upper village terraces toward a viewpoint. Broad safe walking paths, no floating tiles.
decor: Cable terminals board floor (740,340), arrive floor (1050,240). Twin cables above the cabin path by 80 pixels: (740,260) to (1050,160). Keep shaft/cable empty without cabin. Houses occupy background empty areas, keep route fully visible.
